8 Application by accused for disclosure.
[F28(1) This section applies where the accused has given a defence statement under section 5,

6 or 6B and the prosecutor has complied with section 7A(5) or has purported to comply
with it or has failed to comply with it.

(2) If the accused has at any time reasonable cause to believe that there is prosecution
material which is required by section 7A to be disclosed to him and has not been, he
may apply to the court for an order requiring the prosecutor to disclose it to him.]

(3) For the purposes of this section prosecution material is material—
(a) which is in the prosecutor’s possession and came into his possession in
connection with the case for the prosecution against the accused,
(b) which, in pursuance of a code operative under Part II, he has inspected in
connection with the case for the prosecution against the accused, or
(c) which falls within subsection (4).
